about: A page counts as changed when the content of its <main> differs from the previous release's, with the two site version numbers masked: the header, the footer and the version stamp change on every page at every release and say nothing about what the release did. Pages are compared as built and committed, so the list is what a reader would have seen change. Stored in data/release-pages.json, one entry per release, written once and never recomputed:
